title: RegisterSession followed by UnregisterSession
purpose: Exercise session creation and teardown with correct encapsulation commands and the documented RegisterSession protocol version/options payload.

messages.label: UnregisterSession request using placeholder negotiated handle

expected_behavior: A conforming peer should accept the RegisterSession request or reject it with a normal encapsulation status if unsupported. If a session is established, the UnregisterSession frame should be accepted for teardown when the harness substitutes the returned handle for 01000000.
constraints_preserved: RegisterSession command 0x0065 and UnregisterSession command 0x0066 come from supplied sources
RegisterSession payload length is 4 and encodes protocol version 1 plus options 0
UnregisterSession uses a 24-byte header with zero payload length
Session handle field is a static placeholder intended for runtime substitution from the RegisterSession response
issue_safety_notes: Safe stateful coverage only; avoids oversized or inconsistent command data and does not rely on vulnerable CPF parsing.
